annotations.title: How long a HUD 232 loan takes

description: How long a HUD Section 232 loan takes, from HUD's own closing records: for 223(f), median and middle-half days from firm application to underwriter assignment, firm commitment and closing, with estimated dates from a firm application date you give; for 223(a)(7), new construction and 241(a), firm-commitment-to-closing medians by fiscal year.

firm_application_date.description: Date the lender submits (or submitted) the firm application, YYYY-MM-DD. Optional; with it, the steps come back as dates.

from_fiscal_year.description: First fiscal year of firm-commitment-to-closing history to return (default 2023, earliest 2011).

program.description: 223f (refinance or purchase), 223a7 (streamlined refinance of an FHA loan), new-construction (new construction or substantial rehab) or 241a (supplemental loan).
